# Sendsets

> The cold email API for AI agents. Agents connect sending mailboxes, warm them up, build and launch outbound campaigns, add leads, and read and answer replies through an MCP server, a CLI, or a REST API.

- Remote MCP server: https://api.sendsetsapi.com/v1/mcp (streamable HTTP, OAuth 2.1 or API key)
- Website: https://sendsetsapi.com
- Sign up: https://app.sendsetsapi.com/auth/register (free for up to 10 mailboxes)

## Docs

- [Agent quickstart](https://docs.sendsetsapi.com/api/quickstart/): set Sendsets up from an agent end to end
- [MCP server](https://docs.sendsetsapi.com/api/mcp/): endpoint, auth, send-tool approval policy
- [CLI](https://docs.sendsetsapi.com/api/cli/): the `sendsets` command line
- [API reference](https://docs.sendsetsapi.com/api/): REST endpoints, errors, permissions
- [OpenAPI spec](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AddisonHoff/sendsets/main/openapi.json)

## Skills

- [send-cold-email](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AddisonHoff/sendsets/main/skills/send-cold-email/SKILL.md): send cold email and run outbound campaigns from an agent
- [sendsets](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AddisonHoff/sendsets/main/skills/sendsets/SKILL.md): turn a product into outbound campaigns and run them
- [sendsets-cli](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/AddisonHoff/sendsets/main/skills/sendsets-cli/SKILL.md): drive Sendsets from a terminal
- [claude.md](https://sendsetsapi.com/claude.md): one-link starting point for coding agents
